HINT_EXITPATH: Where EXIT in the In-Game Menu goes. Best left empty with BOOT LOCK on (PS2BBL, FMCB or OSDMenu, or BIBLE set up): EXIT then goes through the browser, which starts your boot loader and RIPPS2 as at power on, the safest way back. Empty without the lock: RIPPS2's own ELF on a memory card or a FAT32 USB drive, loaded straight after the reset, which not every game leaves the console ready for. Browser: the PS2 browser. An ELF on MMCE can't be reached then at all.
HINT_RIPPS2_BOOT_LOCK: Starts RIPPS2 at power on through your boot loader: PS2BBL and FMCB start it at once, OSDMenu puts it first in its menu, and a game's EXIT goes back the same way. Off puts back what was there before. None yet? Boot Loader installs BIBLE.
